title: Harness Hub 0473656 prompt context harness loop sync
summary: Updated the local Harness Hub source checkout to origin/main at 047365688dcdeeb5ef0489095a4b8b1c65f0122b, refreshed the aggregation manifest, migrated target-safe context engineering and loop engineering resources under .harness-hub, and expanded the local harness init and validation gates while preserving AI daily production effective-interact renderer adaptations.

validation_commands: red manifest stale check failed before update with manifest commit c603b2ac333d2071a394a29c2dfe90d02e1197aa versus origin/main 047365688dcdeeb5ef0489095a4b8b1c65f0122b
source CLI init-harness dry-run for this target

lessons.lesson: Harness Hub target-safe migration should use managed outputs and local adaptation, not source-repo wholesale copies.
lessons.evidence: The dry-run identified .harness-hub state, context, loop, evaluator, and quality outputs while also blocking root overwrites and dirty skill files; the final migration copied target resources and kept source packaging out of the repository.
lessons.recommended_action: For future Harness Hub updates, run the source CLI dry-run first and migrate only target-safe managed outputs unless the user explicitly asks to adopt source-repo packaging.

lessons.lesson: Production effective-interact adaptations must survive Harness Hub full-overwrite sync.
lessons.evidence: The first npm run validate attempt reached npm run test and failed 21 tests after active effective-interact files were overwritten; restoring those local adaptations brought the diff back to harness/context/loop resources.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep feedback/p1-effective-interact-production-renderer in the regression self-check for every Harness Hub sync and do not accept skill overwrite results until npm run test or npm run validate proves the production renderer contract.

suggestions.issue: The existing update script still reports full-overwrite copiedFiles for effective-interact even when the target must preserve local renderer adaptations.
suggestions.evidence: The aggregation manifest records copied files from the upstream sync, while validation required restoring local active effective-interact files to keep the daily renderer tests viable.
suggestions.suggestion: Consider moving high-risk target-adapted skills such as effective-interact to preserve-conflicts or adding a per-skill local-adaptation allowlist.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future Harness Hub syncs would preserve upstream evidence without temporarily breaking production daily rendering tests.
suggestions.promotion_path: Future project_iteration after user confirmation; would need updater tests and manifest semantics.

followups.action: Evaluate whether scripts/update-harness-hub.mjs should support per-skill preserve-conflicts for effective-interact and other target-adapted skills.
